title: 4.6 Getting ready for school day routine
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
sub_lesson_title: Getting ready for school day routine
goal: Describe getting ready for school in order with first, then, after that and finally.
grammar_function: Describe getting ready for school in order with first, then, after that and finally.
prerequisite: Familiar Unit 1 people/actions, Unit 2 objects/park, Unit 3 speakers/possessions and Unit 4 home/morning language.
speaking_outcome: Describe getting ready for school in order with first, then, after that and finally.

cards.pedagogy_note:
The same boy sits up in bed, awake, in morning light.
Introduce FIRST at the beginning of this morning. Indicate the first scene in the six-photo strip.

The boy washes his face at the bathroom sink, still in pajamas.
Introduce THEN through wake up → wash face. Indicate the two consecutive moments.

The boy is fully covered and buttons his blue school shirt in the bedroom.
Introduce AFTER THAT through wash face → get dressed. Indicate the move to the next action.

Now dressed for school, the boy eats breakfast at the kitchen table.
Continue the same morning with THEN. Connect getting dressed to eating breakfast.
